subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should reasoning presentation become a portable shared contract, plugin-owned channel configuration, or remain fixed with only concrete rendering bugs addressed?
rationale: The UX gap is proven, but current code and policy do not determine the permanent owner, cross-channel capabilities, or precedence of a new public setting.

options.title: Portable presentation contract
options.body: Add a typed shared presentation mode that channel plugins map to supported native rendering while preserving the current default.

options.title: Channel-owned settings
options.body: Let individual channel plugins expose only their safe native reasoning formats without an agent-level override.

options.title: Keep fixed presentation
options.body: Avoid a new configuration surface and handle malformed markup or readability defects as focused channel bugs.

recommendation.title: Portable presentation contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed shared presentation mode that channel plugins map to supported native rendering while preserving the current default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest implementation and review history for the shared formatter and Telegram presentation path.
